name: Sweet Valentine Chocolatier
source:
Spring is knocking at your shop's door --
-- and so are your four potential love interests! 

As a chocolatier, can you balance work, romance, and mini games during the
Spring Festival season? 

Or will you melt under the pressure? 🫠

Who will you choose (if anyone) to get sticky with? 🍫

[From [url=https://bigmamafatcat.itch.io/sweet-valentine-chocolatier-prototype]itch.io[/url]]
